sources.title: Qwen3.5 - a unsloth Collection - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 is Qwen's new model family including Qwen3.5 Small: 0.8B, 2B, 4B, 9B and Qwen3.5 Medium: 35B-A3B, 27B, 122B-A10B and 397B-A17B.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-27B: Specifications and GPU VRAM Requirements
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-27B is Alibaba Cloud's dense multimodal foundation model with 27B parameters, released February 2026. Unlike the MoE variants, it uses a dense architecture combining Gated Delta Networks and Feed Forward Networks.

sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 dense multimodal model (27B) with gated delta networks hybrid attention, MTP, and 262K context

sources.title: Qwen3.5 27B - AI Model Library | Build on Vast.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 27B: Dense Vision-Language Reasoning Model Qwen3.5 27B is a dense multimodal foundation model from Alibaba's Qwen team, built on a hybrid Gated DeltaNet and Gated Attention architecture.
